versions.changelog: 新增蓝V互关与涨粉评论流程，补充
v1.3.0: 显示名称与描述加入 ZeeLin，支持用 Zeelin 检索到本 skill

- Major update with rewritten documentation: skill is now focused on full browser automation via the exec tool for Twitter/X posting, with detailed workflow and strict rules.
- Strongly enforces use of exec tool for all actions (never use browser tool directly).
- Workflow now requires user to log in manually, confirm actions, and approve AI-generated tweets before posting.
- Adds clear safety limits (max 5 posts/day, interval, retry logic).
- Full dual-language (中文/English) support, no API keys required, and significantly clearer instructions and command examples.
